verdict.caption: Verdict for B over A · indicative
verdict.indicative_note: The verdict is indicative: it compares label contents per unit of cost and does not account for absorption, quality or your own needs.
verdict.market_fallback: Market rate here is A's own cost per content point, because fewer than 3 products in this market have content (market of {{ marketSize }}).

verdict.worth_it: B costs {{ deltaCostPerDay }} {{ currency }} more per day and adds {{ deltaContent }} content points. That extra costs {{ marginalRate }} {{ currency }} per point, {{ ratio }}× the market rate of {{ mRef }} {{ currency }}: worth it.
verdict.marginal: B costs {{ deltaCostPerDay }} {{ currency }} more per day and adds {{ deltaContent }} content points. That extra costs {{ marginalRate }} {{ currency }} per point, {{ ratio }}× the market rate of {{ mRef }} {{ currency }}: marginal.
verdict.not_worth_it: B costs {{ deltaCostPerDay }} {{ currency }} more per day for {{ deltaContent }} content points. That extra costs {{ marginalRate }} {{ currency }} per point, {{ ratio }}× the market rate of {{ mRef }} {{ currency }}: not worth it.
verdict.dominates: B costs at most the same per day and has more content: {{ deltaContent }} content points more.
verdict.equivalent: Both products cost the same per day and have the same content.
verdict.insufficient_data: There is not enough data to judge whether the extra cost of B is worth it.
